result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontally scrolling restaurant carousel ('Fastest near you') clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll affordance, which can look broken. Other elements are visually consistent.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol') is cut off at the right screen edge with its name truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or peek padding, making it appear broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding/peek so a partial card is clearly visible as scrollable, ensure card titles truncate with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccol…') instead of cutting mid-character, and consider a subtle scroll hint or gradient fade at the edge.

issues.description: The category filter chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) and the 'See all' links rely on color/weight alone in places, and the partially visible chip at the far right is clipped without indication that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Provide a clear selected-state indicator beyond color (e.g., icon or underline), and add horizontal scroll affordance for the chip row so users know more categories are available.

issues.description: The bottom navigation 'Profile' tab is highlighted green while the visible screen is the home/feed view, which may confuse users about the active section.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active tab state matches the currently displayed screen (Home should be highlighted on this feed view), or clarify navigation state.
